lines.zh: 我贴着他走，像一层影子
lines.en: I move with him like a shadow.

lines.zh: 我的身体流动着，没有骨头
lines.en: My body flows, for it has no bones.
I rise from behind his shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟他的脚步
lines.en: I match his steps one by one.

lines.zh: 黑色的东西拖在他身后
lines.en: The blackness trails behind him.
I swim around his arm.

lines.zh: 我不用走路，我在他体内
lines.en: I need not walk; I am inside him.
I extend a hand, then withdraw it.
I spread a layer over his shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的边缘在空气里散开
lines.en: My edges fray into the air.
I rise and fall with his breathing.
I wrap him a little tighter.
I rest beneath his skin.
Only he can hear my voice.
I am leafing through his memories.
I slowly spread out, then draw back.
I am hungry, and I wait.
This place is safe enough.
I am counting his heartbeats.
Part of me stays in the shadow.
I am listening to something far off.
I am a little restless.
I look at you from his shoulder.
You can see me. Good.
He is not me; I am myself.

lines.zh: 我说话的时候他也听得见
lines.en: He hears me too when I speak.
I am smelling you.
There is something sweet on you.
I have more than two eyes.
Do you want to talk to me?
I have always been courteous to him.
You should make a choice too.

lines.zh: 你在看我的手，不是他的
lines.en: You are watching my hand, not his.
I am more patient than you think.
Part of me is scattered.
I withdraw inside him.
I cannot cry out just now.
I pulled him back.
My edges have grown thin.
I need a little time.
The body shuddered once.
I gather myself slowly.
We can still move.
You really struck hard.
I smell meat.
I will taste a little of this.
I do not eat anything cooked.
You yourself smell better.
One piece will be enough.
He is hungry too; I eat for him.

lines.zh: 再退半步，我快忍不住了。
lines.en: Half a step farther — I'm barely holding back.
This smell excites me.
For now I am only looking.
I am pressed back inside him.
I reached out and struck you.
I have little solid form anyway.
That scattered a part of me.
I have gathered myself again.
Where I touched you is cold.
What you touched was not his hand.
I slide off you and away.
Do not come so near his body.
He moves along with me.
This body has no need of that.
Right now there are only the two of us.
I am interested only in him.
That has nothing to do with him.
It is already crowded inside him.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有这种说法
lines.en: We have no such word between us.
I guard him. That is all there is.
Let us not speak of it.
We will keep walking.
If he disagrees, I drop it.
I extend a hand and take it.
I swallow it straight down.
It dissolves slowly inside me.
He does not want it; I do.
I hide it beneath the skin.
This may be useful later.
I taste it; it is iron.
I must show it to him.
This portion counts as mine.
I hear a living heartbeat.
He needs to eat right now.
I am making a request.
You are free to refuse.
But I will take it myself.
I press down on his hand.
He is still hesitating.
You had better not refuse me.
This near, one reach is enough.

lines.zh: 我的身体已经伸出去了
lines.en: My body is already extended.
Did you see that clearly?
This time it is for his sake.
I have counted to three inside.
I have stayed beside you.
I am far faster than he is.
I see wherever you go.
Part of me moves along the wall.
You are clearly still wavering.
I heard you swallow.
I put a little pressure on him.
This choice is not hard to make.
Retreat, and we will not follow.
I have been waiting right here.
His heartbeat has quickened.
The two of us come together.
You still have not answered me.
More thought will find no other way.
I am one step from you.
My body lashes out.
That felt like a whip.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过了你的护甲
lines.en: My hand passed through your armor.
He is straining on his side too.
That blow was for him.
The blackness coils round your leg.
You are dragged a step by us.
I have let go; do not fear.
I will not hurt him.
That strike hurt me as well.
We have come around your flank.
You blocked that one.
We are very close now.
I pulled the force back.
I wake inside the meteor.
This body is still empty.
I extend one thin thread.
The light here is too sharp.
First I tasted the air.
I need a host.
My surface moves slowly.
It is cold inside the stone.
I hear footsteps.
In the meteor's crack, I coil tighter.
I have been waiting all along.
Fire makes me curl into a ball.
We fell together.

lines.zh: 水把我们两个人都呛住
lines.en: Water chokes us both.
The blast tears us apart.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过了我的身体
lines.en: Something pierces my body.
That force burns inside me.
Hunger is making me lose control.
Lightning enters and my whole mass numbs.

lines.zh: 这里没有宿主，也没有血
lines.en: No host here, and no blood.
